correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all eight published ODEs with the displayed positive exact parameter family. Solving stationary equations reduces every positive endemic equilibrium bijectively to P_theta(a)=0; all denominators are strictly positive and the zero-infection branch is unique. The discriminant and root sum/product give exactly 2/1/0 positive roots on the complete theta>=0 range. Full eight-dimensional exact rational Jacobian characteristic polynomials are independently computed and equal the analytic factorizations; the exact rational Routh first columns have respectively 0,1,0 right-half-plane sign changes at the disease-free, lower and upper theta=0 equilibria. No finite experiment substitutes for the analytic all-policy classification; there is no claim of global extinction.

value.rationale: The model includes two distinct natural controls—vaccination of never-infected susceptible people and vaccination after recovery. For the latter, the disease-free R0 is blind to the intervention despite strong nonlinear reinfection feedback. The exact theta_c and two coexisting local attracting basins show a mathematically consequential policy boundary for removal of established infection at constant subunit R0. The sharp extinction-versus-endemic equilibrium diagram in this exact original model is not a textbook threshold deduction or mere table recomputation; it exposes a physically interpretable limitation of invasion-based policy criteria. Scope is deliberately limited to mathematically admissible rational parameter rates and local basin conclusions.
